conjecture: The residue-dependent solvability obstruction is a well-defined GROUP HOMOMORPHISM o_nu : H^2_+ -> C^3 / A(Z^2_o(sigma)), [beta] |-> [Q beta], that KILLS B^2_+ (additive coboundaries), and whose kernel is exactly the image of the additive forgetful map: im phi^+ = ker o_nu. Equivalently: an additive class [beta] extends to a full skew-brace cocycle inducing the good triplet (nu, mu, sigma) iff o_nu([beta]) = 0. This is the HONEST REPAIR of the refuted [nu] perp [Omega] product (nu-omega-independence-refuted-coupling): the residue nu, the circle twist sigma, and the additive class [beta] are COUPLED through o_nu, not independent. Proved in the trivial-brace-kernel (Rathee-Yadav) regime; the proof is structural, resting on (i) Z-linearity of the coupling operators P,Q, (ii) the linchpin identity P(T d_o theta_1) = Q(d_+ theta) (a formal identity = RY's B^2 subset Z^2 on component (c)), and (iii) RY's cocycle characterisation Z^2_Sb <=> (a)+(b)+(c) (arXiv:2601.12371). The |G|=8 collapse reads o_nu(b)=0 <=> (1+nu)b in 2 D^sigma; the |G|=16 three-way lock 4b = 2(nu sigma - 1) mod 8 and the torsor/basepoint dichotomy are COMPUTED for a non-trivial-brace kernel and lie OUTSIDE RY (flagged open for a general proof).

tree.approach: o_nu : H^2_+ -> C^3/A(Z^2_o) is a well-defined additive homomorphism killing B^2_+, with im phi^+ = ker o_nu, in the trivial-brace-kernel (RY) regime. Structural proof: linear P,Q + the linchpin coboundary identity + RY's cocycle characterisation. The honest repair of the refuted [nu] perp [Omega] product.

children.approach: Theorem 1: (1) o_nu kills B^2_+ so descends to H^2_+; (2) o_nu is a group homomorphism (Q is Z-linear, A(Z^2_o) a subgroup); (3) im phi^+ = ker o_nu. The whole content is the linchpin formal identity P(T d_o theta_1) = Q(d_+ theta) (= RY's B^2 subset Z^2 on component (c)) plus RY's cocycle characterisation; the (superset) direction CONSTRUCTS the brace cocycle and does not presuppose one, avoiding the circular step of the refuted argument.

BLACK BOX (cited, not re-proved): the Rathee-Yadav characterisation (beta, tau) in Z^2_Sb <=> (a) beta in Z^2_+, (b) tau in Z^2_o, (c) the coupling P(T tau) = Q beta; and their B^2 subset Z^2 (coboundaries are cocycles) as a formal identity in theta and the triplet. Cross-validated: abstract ker o_nu = genuine im phi^+ from an independent regular-subgroup-of-holomorph enumeration (2026-09-29-o-nu-kernel-vs-image.py, PASS).
